an3.43:1.1: Tayo bhikkhave atthavase sampassamānena alam eva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
an3.43:1.3: Yo dhammaṃ deseti so attha-paṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca,
an3.43:1.4: yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca,
an3.43:1.5: yo c' eva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthapaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammapaṭisaṃvedino ca.
an3.43:1.6: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo atthavase sampassamānena alaṃ eva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetun
